mentions.name: LLM photo memory experiments
mentions.description: A set of experiments exploring how LLMs visually understand a person's photos to learn about them, informed by recent findings from deepseek-OCR. Part of the experiments store the extracted memories with GraphRAG so they can be effectively retrieved without losing too much information.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a set of experiments that explores LLMs visual understanding of your photos to learn about you, especially given the recent learnings from deepseek-OCR. Part of the experiments delve into storing the memories with GraphRAG so they can be effectively retrieved without losing too information.
